transcript.text: What's worth landing for in this system?

Phroi Pruae VW-G d8-1243 4 a: 3 genera mapped — Concha, Bacterium, Tussock. You've 1 of 3 samples of Concha Labiata; Concha and Tussock are new to your codex. Nobody has landed here before, so every sample pays five times over.
How much am I carrying unsold?
About 52 million credits in exploration and organic data since the last sale at your carrier. Worth a trip back once this system is done — the carrier is six jumps behind you.

speech.instructions: Calm, competent ship computer. Even tone, unhurried, no enthusiasm. Speak clearly and briskly.

items: **A stronger default model** for the assistant.
**Whisper listens by default**, on your PC, so hearing you needs no OpenAI key.
**First release.** EDSSI follows your journal while you play and shows the session at a glance: where you are, where you're heading, your fuel, and what your unsold data is worth.
**Mission tab.** The route ahead, the bodies worth a probe, and the life in each system, with the species likely to grow there and what each could pay.
**An assistant you can talk to.** Ask about your trip, your ship or the galaxy by voice or text. It searches Spansh, plots routes, reads the web, and answers aloud.
**Routes from Spansh.** Load a route's CSV and EDSSI puts the next system on the clipboard after every jump, with a 3D map of the whole trip.

**Materials, commodities and ships.** Engineering to-do lists and the trades that cover them, shopping lists with market searches and buying plans, and every ship you own slot by slot, ready to open in EDSY or Coriolis.
**Warnings in flight.** Low fuel, unscoopable stars ahead, high gravity, carriers nearby, and your own carrier about to jump.
**Uploads.** Sends your journal to EDSM, Inara and EDDN, so you don't need another tool running for that.
**Keeps itself up to date.** New versions download in the background and install the next time EDSSI starts.
